req.title: Return JSON content type
req.statement: The system shall return application/json Content-Type on all /tasks endpoints returning a body.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that all /tasks endpoints must return a JSON content type. This is crucial for ensuring that clients can correctly parse the response. The test suite includes a positive test to verify correct behavior, a negative test to handle client errors, and a boundary test to check the response when no tasks are available.

tests.name: test_get_tasks_returns_json
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running in test mode.
actions: Send a GET request to the /tasks/ endpoint.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.get("/tasks/")
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.headers["Content-Type"] == "application/json"

tests.name: test_get_task_not_found_returns_404
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running in test mode.
actions: Send a GET request to the /tasks/9999 endpoint where task 9999 does not exist.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.get("/tasks/9999")
assert response.status_code == 404
assert response.headers["Content-Type"] == "application/json"

tests.name: test_get_tasks_with_limit_boundary
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running in test mode.
actions: Send a GET request to the /tasks/ endpoint with limit=0.
expected: The response body is an empty list.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.get("/tasks/?limit=0")
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.headers["Content-Type"] == "application/json"
assert response.json() == []
